title: Parse and validate tool calls
summary: Parse tool calls from a raw model reply and validate their arguments against a JSON Schema subset with JSON pointer error paths.

mutants.additional_default_false: Treats a schema without additionalProperties as if it were false, so extra keys always fail.
mutants.bool_is_integer: Tests int before bool, so true and false count as integers.
mutants.escape_order: Escapes / before ~ in a path segment, so ~1 becomes ~01.
mutants.no_return_after_type: Keeps checking the children after a type error, so one bad value gives extra errors.
mutants.required_after_props: Reports missing required properties after the errors of the keys.
mutants.single_decode: Does not decode the arguments string, so the arguments stay a JSON string.
